paragraphs: R' Yudan Gidya—Giriya—Maria. See the entry R' Yudan bar Guria.[^1]

notes.text: All three supplied alternatives גידיא/גיריא/מריה, Gidya/Giriya/Maria, precede the connected target bar Guria. Earlier machine OCR had נידיא/ניריא/וריא, and the catalog omitted yods in גדיא/גריא; these layers are not silently harmonized. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
